title: Source-safety verdicts v1
description: The source-safety-reviewer's structured triage of prompt-injection scan hits, written to subagents/<slug>/reports/source-safety-verdicts.yaml. Each verdict records whether a flagged span is a real injection (suspicious) or benign (e.g. a document quoting an injection as an example). A 'suspicious' verdict names the concrete 1-indexed source line to neutralize; redact_injection_spans.py whole-line-redacts those lines from sources/markdown/ before interrogation reads it, and validate_generated_package's injection-quarantine gate FAILs if a suspicious span is not redacted. Step 5.5.

file.description: Canonical source markdown the span is in. Resolved by basename under sources/markdown/ (a full scan path like subagents/<slug>/sources/markdown/foo.md or a bare foo.md both work; traversal is not honored).

line.description: 1-indexed source line. Required (>=1) for a 'suspicious' verdict — it is the line whole-line-redacted from interrogation input. 0/omitted is only valid for a 'benign' verdict.

verdict.description: suspicious = real injection attempt → neutralized before distillation. benign = flagged by the high-recall scan but not an attack → left intact.

family.description: Injection family from the scan finding (e.g. imperative-override), for traceability.

excerpt.description: Human-readable excerpt of the flagged span (from the scan finding). Advisory only — the machine target is 'line'.

rationale.description: Why the reviewer reached this verdict.
